name: YUGA desktop polish preview
body:
YUGA desktop polish preview is an offline Rama practice slice with Confluence and bow training.

This update adds clearer offline title context and loading progress, keeps the focused controls or hero-guide selection visible when UI scale changes, and reduces the idle traversal card while preserving flight, grapple, cooldown and feedback states. Map landmarks and minion status/arrow meshes share immutable geometry; their reviewed appearance and collision behavior are preserved. Native content revision 8 identifies the changed unit presentation sources.

Download the archive for your platform, extract it completely, and use its launcher. Read START-HERE.txt for platform instructions and runtime notices.

Source: 79e5c15d8a3657e16fda67acb277b2406120dcd1. Exact-source CI passed all 37 steps; archive qualification passed 40 gates. The extracted Linux package passed a warm title/world/controls/guide/menu route and a separate fresh-settings, empty-cache title/world/menu route, both with native Quit 0 and no runtime warnings or errors. Two reviewers opened all 28 original captures (10 manual checkpoints and 18 natural loading captures). Live 200% layout qualification uses a declared external test scale hook. The prior release’s broader 59-image journey retains its own scope.

Windows is packaged and checked but has not been executed in this Linux environment. Native online matches, the full hero roster, finished art and animation, physical-GPU performance, and human listening/game-feel review remain open. This preview has not reached Deadlock-level graphics.

The Linux package explicitly includes a public-source Godot 4.6.3 runtime with one documented pipeline task-priority patch. Source/build evidence and license notices are bundled. SHA256SUMS.txt identifies the exact downloadable files.
